tool_input.command:
cd /workspace/task && cat > solve.py << 'EOF'
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, Alignment
from copy import copy

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# 1. Fill E3:E15 with VLOOKUP referencing column O age(year) into YEAR(age)/CATEGORY table
for r in range(3, 16):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=5).value = f'=VLOOKUP(O{r},$H$3:$I$11,2,FALSE)'

# 2. Actual Age column P (next column after age(year)=O)
# Header P2
hdr = ws.cell(row=2, column=16, value='Actual Age')
hdr.font = Font(bold=True)
hdr.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='top')
# match fill of O2 (none) - leave as is

# Data P3:P15
for r in range(3, 16):
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=16)
    c.value = f'=ROUND(($B$1-C{r})/365,0)'
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='center')
    c.number_format = '0'
    # match fill color of preceding column O cell
    c.fill = copy(ws.cell(row=r, column=15).fill)

wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('saved')
EOF
